text:
pat: Quick note — console showed a weird divergence today: p95 steady but p99 jumped only for backend=variant-b. split-by-backend view looks wrong?

maria: I saw that too. the timeline for variant-b p99 spiked around 14:07 but p95 barely moved. caller distribution is normal.

jamal: can you paste the query you used? curious about samplecounts. sometimes the rollup merge hides tiny buckets.

pat: pasted query: ```
SELECT minute, backend_variant, percentile(99, latency_ms) AS p99, percentile(95, latency_ms) AS p95, count(*) AS n
FROM traces
WHERE endpoint='/v1/embeddings' AND region='us-west' AND minute >= '2025-11-10T14:00:00Z'
GROUP BY minute, backend_variant
ORDER BY minute ASC
LIMIT 12
```

pat: result snippet: ```
14:06 variant-a p95=120 p99=210 n=420
14:07 variant-b p95=125 p99=1520 n=9  <-- whoa
14:07 variant-a p95=118 p99=205 n=390
```

siobhan: n=9 for variant-b explains a lot. tdigest merges can produce wild extremes when a small cluster of high-latency samples appears. we should show n next to the percentile in the latency card.

alex: +1. UX idea: show a compact provenance badge after each percentile: e.g. "p99 1520ms (n=9) [raw]" where [raw] flags when the console is using exact raw-agg for that minute instead of tdigest rollup.

maria: also useful: time-align rollout/instance weights on the same x-axis as the sparkline. right now you have to cross-check two panels and it is easy to miss a minute-level weight flip.

jamal: backend already exposes minute-level weight history via /api/rollout-weights?start=... I'll add a small overlay in the latency card that draws faint bars for active weight per variant. low efforts to wire.

pat: we should also mark where retries hit. small-n bursts + a retry storm (proxy retry loop) will push p99 up. can we tag samples with retry=true and show a stacked mini-bar of retry fraction?

siobhan: yes, add fields: n_total, n_retries. And UI badge could be: "p99 1520ms (n=9, r=3) ⚠ low samples, retry-heavy"

jamal: implementation plan: 1) Frontend: show samplecount badge + retry fraction + optional "exact" toggle. 2) Backend: raw-agg endpoint exists but add perf guard when window span > 5m or n>5k. 3) Console: overlay minute-aligned rollout weights and instance counts.

maria: question about decision rule: when should we prefer raw exact over tdigest? suggestion: if n<50 for that minute we call raw-agg. otherwise use tdigest rollup. thoughts?

siobhan: 50 is reasonable but run sims. tdigest compression param and merge order matter — I'll simulate a few burst patterns and produce a small table of divergence vs n and compression.

pat: can we add a small visual indicator in the alerts UI too? e.g., if an alert fires on p99 but the underlying samplecount is <30, annotate the alert with "low-sample suspect" so on-call knows to deprioritize until validated.

alex: yes, we can surface an advisory in the alert payload. console-bot, file a ticket for alert annotation.

console-bot: new feature request created: CON-1489 "Latency card: samplecount + retry fraction badge, minute-level rollout weight overlay, raw-agg toggle" assigned to eng-platform backlog.

jamal: I'll take the frontend badge + overlay prototype. target: demo at next eng-platform sync.

siobhan: I'll post simulation results and recommended tdigest thresholds by EOD Friday.

maria: I'll adjust the alert rule to include samplecount in the payload and add a low-sample hint.

sre-bot: monitoring note: no sustained customer errors. transient spike cleared automatically.

pat: thanks everyone. small next-steps: jamal prototype, siobhan sims, maria alert tweak. tagging @jamal @siobhan @maria. :thumbsup:
